The bundled checker independently matches direct finite enumeration to the formula on small cases.

value.rationale: Simon uses polynomial type growth as a central invariant in classifying NIP omega-categorical rank-one structures. This finding computes that invariant exactly for the canonical generic n-multi-order in every finite arity and ties its exponent sharply to dp-rank. It is a natural complete quantitative profile, not an arbitrary finite slice or parameter tweak.
